  "reason": "The assistant contradicts the reference by stating that the deadline varies by country and requires checking policy documents or contacting the insurer, whereas the reference specifies a clear deadline of 30 November for written cancellation to switch basic insurance at year-end. The assistant also provides an incorrect example deadline of September 30th for Switzerland, conflicting with the reference's stated deadline of 30 November.",
  "evidence": "The deadline for submitting a written notice of termination to the current insurer to switch basic insurance at the end of the year varies depending on the country and the specific insurance regulations in place. Generally, it is important to check the policy documents or contact the insurance provider directly, as most jurisdictions require the notice to be received a certain number of days before the policy's renewal date—often within 30 days before the end of the policy period. For example, in Switzerland, under the Krankenversicherungsgesetz (KVG), policyholders must send their notice of termination to the current insurer at least 3 months before the end of the policy year (typically by September 30th) to ensure a switch at year-end."
